text: A UK-resident Monzo personal current-account holder can approve an outgoing bank transfer in the app when the required details and available balance are in place. Monzo supports Faster Payments, subject to its checks and processing.
scope: Monzo Bank Limited personal Current Account in the UK; outgoing Faster Payment for a household, under terms dated 18 August 2026
uncertainty: Approval can have an undo window; Monzo may refuse or delay a transfer. This account example does not establish interbank final settlement, universal bank behavior or card-payment rules.

text: A person controlling spending keys can authorize and broadcast a Bitcoin main-chain transaction to a recipient output. Inclusion in a validated block and further confirmations increase confidence against replacement.
scope: Self-custodied Bitcoin main-chain output and household key holder; transaction authorization, block inclusion and confirmations only
uncertainty: Broadcast does not assure payment and confirmations are not absolute finality. Fees, inclusion timing, key loss, merchant acceptance, refunds, legal recourse and cash-out are separate questions.

text: A household may offer a current Bank of England note for an in-person purchase in England or Wales. The shop can choose whether to accept it; legal-tender status does not compel retail acceptance.
scope: Current Bank of England note; England and Wales; household offering it to a merchant, under the Bank of England explainer updated 26 February 2025
uncertainty: This source does not establish a particular shop’s policy, whether a purchase is completed, counterfeit handling, cash costs, privacy in a specific transaction, or rules for other UK notes and coins.

text: Circle’s terms give a US household holding native Ethereum USDC without a Mint account no direct redemption route with Circle. Mint eligibility is currently institutional, and $1 is an intended issuer value subject to its terms.
scope: Circle LLC native Ethereum USDC; US non-EEA household wallet holder without Circle Mint; issuer terms dated 12 December 2025 and Mint agreement dated 24 July 2026
uncertainty: This is a contract-rights description only. It does not establish market cash-out price, USD purchasing-power preservation, independent reserve sufficiency, third-party wallet protection or named-issuer regulatory compliance.
